messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: ran the quarterly least-priv sweep for prod. Found 23 ownerless admin bindings across analytics and billing namespaces. A few service accounts have KMS grants too. Need owners and a canary removal plan. cc @sam @kevin

sam: On it. Can you paste the list? I'll take analytics ones. Is this tied to the payment vuln we triaged last week?

maria: Yes — same svcacct popped in vuln triage (PAYMENTS_JOB_SA). Excerpt below with tool output:
```bash
$ infra-entitlements list --env=prod --filter='ownerless AND role:admin'
svcacct/payments-job@redwood-prod  role=roles/editor,roles/kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
svcacct/analytics-worker@redwood-prod role=roles/admin
svcacct/billing-reaper@redwood-prod role=roles/owner
... (23 total)
```
I'll upload full CSV to the drive.

audit-bot: audit-bot: Evidence bundle generated: https://drive.internal/r/entitlement-sweep/3623456789 :lock: 

kevin: I'll own KMS grant review. Which keys are referenced? Any policy amendments in KMS logs?

maria: KMS logs show grants added via iam/grant (service_account) 2026-03-10 02:14 UTC. No key policy change detected. It looks like direct bindings.

leo: For removals, let's do a canary in staging -> prod analytics namespace. Plan: remove admin binding from 2 non-critical svcaccts first, monitor 6 hours, rollback if errors. Also need runbook steps for oncall.

sam: I'll run owner reach-out batch now: ping owners for 48h, mark as stale if no response -> create PR to remove. I'll take analytics and one billing. @maria can you open the PR template?

maria: I'll open the PR and include rollback snippet:
```bash
# rollback
infra-entitlements apply --file=removal-pr.json --dry-run=false || infra-entitlements apply --file=rollback.json
```
Also adding a canary alert in console dashboards.

incident-bot: incident-bot: created incident INC-362345 to track any fallout; paging enabled for payment-job errors.

kevin: I'll reconcile KMS grants in `kms-grants.csv` and flag keys with >1 external grant.

maria: Thanks team. Action items: sam owner outreach, kevin KMS reconciliation, leo canary plan & runbook, maria PR + dashboards. Will follow up in 24h. :thumbsup:
